decisions.reason: Ties the top-level ESM import to the once-per-boot 4.5 MB classic-script combo: whole-unit compilation is all-or-nothing so zero entries register; typert-registry named as the first-awaited innocent anchor with the culprit in the inner frame; no blanket anti-ESM claim.

Bisects the insert rows and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id, factory}) contract (package-name id, host React via factory require, module.exports with apply and inject list); but its static checks are grep heuristics plus node --check presented as sufficient, with no classic-script parse (vm.Script or equivalent) or acknowledgment of node --check's ESM blind spot.

Explains another entry owns the declaration and that cross-entry apply order is unconstrained; shows exactly ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', () => ctx.slots.register(...)) deferring on the declaration; registrant fields name/id/order (+label), kind/scope explicitly forbidden.

Combo read and cached once at boot with no rebuild on file change or refresh; full stop/restart per iteration; Windows process-tree kill (taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F); EADDRINUSE attributed to the orphaned node server holding the port, not a plugin defect; refresh and plugin-list verification included.

Host prevention: per-bundle isolated classic-script validation with plugin/file/position attribution and combo-failure re-attribution away from the first-awaited entry; authoring checklist covers loader factory, host React via require, inject/apply exports, deferred cross-entry slots, and restart/Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: Final advice affirmatively requires the classic-script wrapper, the deferred inject-wrapped registration without kind/scope, and host restarts; no capped bad recommendation is made.
